title: Post Sample Index PCR Size Selection using SPRIselect
author: Opentrons
materials: The samples and beads are mixed
Samples are left to elute for 2 minutes

steps.title: Add SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of SPRI beads to each sample.

steps.title: Mix beads with samples
steps.instruction: Mix the samples with the added SPRI beads thoroughly.

steps.title: Incubate beads
steps.instruction: Incubate the bead–sample mixture for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Engage magnet and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 5 minutes to pellet the beads, then carefully remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash beads with ethanol
steps.instruction: Wash the bead pellet twice with 200 µL of ethanol, removing the ethanol after each wash.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL ethanol, incubate briefly, remove ethanol

steps.title: Disengage magnet
steps.instruction: Turn off or disengage the magnetic module.

steps.title: Add elution buffer
steps.instruction: Add 41 µL of elution solution to the beads and mix gently.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 2 minutes to allow elution.

steps.title: Engage magnet for elution
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 5 minutes to separate beads from eluate.

steps.title: Transfer eluate
steps.instruction: Transfer 40 µL of the cleared eluate to column 4 of the 96‑well plate.
